options.name: port
options.label: Everything HTTP server port
options.description: Port of Everything's built-in HTTP server (Everything -> Tools -> Options -> HTTP Server -> Server port). It must match the port enabled there.

options.name: timeout
options.label: Everything HTTP timeout (seconds)
options.description: How long to wait for Everything before giving up. Everything answers in about a millisecond, so only raise this on a very busy machine.

tools.name: everything_search
tools.description: Find files and folders by name anywhere on the machine, using the Everything index (Everything from https://www.voidtools.com/ must be running with its HTTP server enabled). Answers in about a millisecond, so prefer this over a recursive directory walk. Pass a filename or a fragment, NOT a full path; a path is answered with a hint instead of results. An empty result is a real 'nothing indexed matches', so it is safe to report the file as missing - but a returned 'error:' line means Everything itself is not answering, and then nothing can be concluded about the file. Search syntax: ext:jpg;png for extensions; "exact phrase" for an exact name; dm:today / dm:yesterday / dm:2026-01-31 for the modified date; size:tiny|small|medium|large|huge|gigantic; folder:name to match folders NAMED name; parent:C:\Projects to list one folder's contents; AND / OR / NOT for boolean logic; regex:^test.*\.py$ for a pattern. Combine them to keep results small, e.g. 'ext:md size:small dm:today'.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Filename, part of a name, or a filter expression. Do not pass a full path. At least 2 significant characters, max 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip this many results to page further (default 0). Use the offset the previous call reported when it said more results are available.
